title: Unit check (oral and written)
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 2: Friends of nature; Layla in the snow; Salem at the zoo
source: Written for arabic/y4 lesson 12 (Pupil PDF worksheet: unit check (oral and written))
intro: Lesson 12: Review and check: nature, reading and sentences. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

arabic.text:
الحَدِيقَةُ جَمِيلَةٌ.
العُصْفُورُ عَلَى الشَّجَرَةِ.
الزَّهْرَةُ تَحْتَ الشَّجَرَةِ.
arabic.ref: Our own text for the Year 4 check

questions.q: Oral and written check on the pupil PDF: label six words, answer three questions on the text, write one instruction and one nominal sentence; then say two sentences to the camera.
questions.a: Labels, answers and sentences from the unit

questions.q: Extend: write a sentence with an instruction and a place: اِجْلِسْ عَلَى الكُرْسِيِّ.
Stretch: write two sentences about your garden or park.
questions.a: For example: الشَّجَرَةُ كَبِيرَةٌ. العُصْفُورُ عَلَى الشَّجَرَةِ.
A) تَحْتَ الشَّجَرَةِ. الزَّهْرَةُ تَحْتَ الشَّجَرَةِ.

questions.q: Think again: which sentence would you teach?
